messages:
Mia Chen: Quick standup on benchmark launch assets. Need three snackable cards + two micro-charts. Goal: make the econ story obvious in one glance and route clicks to the right nurture flows.

Samir Patel: For the cards: one hero stat (unit cost), one tiny sparkline (tokens -> $), and a single-line CTA. Keep alt text for accessibility.

Olivia Gomez: Card slices: chat-short (<=128 tokens), chat-long (512+), and embeddings. Call out hosted vs dedicated vs private in a subtle tag on the card.

Jasper Li: Micro-chart A (tokens->$): x-axis tokens [100,1k,10k,100k], y-axis $ per 1k tokens. Plot two series: mean and p90. Annotate where batching + KV cache yields the biggest gap.

Priya Raman: Micro-chart B (latency vs cost buckets): buckets = ["<50ms","50-150ms","150-400ms","400ms+"], y = median $ per 1k tokens. Color by deployment_type, use dashed fallback line for cold-cache cases.

Samir Patel: Chart config snippet to hand to eng (plain text):

```
chart_type: "latency_cost_buckets"
x: "latency_bucket"
y: "median_cost_per_1k"
series: "deployment_type"
buckets: ["<50ms","50-150ms","150-400ms","400ms+"]
annotations: ["cache_effect", "auto_batching"]
```

Olivia Gomez: Copy direction for cards (3 tones):
- developer: "Ship features that don\u2019t surprise you — predictable latency, predictable cost."
- platform: "One API, multiple deployment profiles. See performance by mode."
- exec: "Lower inference spend while hitting latency targets."

Mia Chen: Nice. For social headers, alternative A: "Benchmarks that map tokens to dollars and ms to SLA risk." Alternative B: "Compare latency and unit cost across deployment options." Pick one.

Jasper Li: Suggest header B for clarity. Also request clear axis labels: x = latency bucket (ms), y = $ / 1k tokens (USD). Units always visible.

Priya Raman: Inbound routing plan: chart_click=creative param. Map: tokens_chart -> pricing-nurture, latency_chart -> reliability-nurture, card_cta_webinar -> webinar-nurture. Use UTM: utm_campaign=bench_launch&utm_medium=social&utm_content={creative}.

Samir Patel: Primary CTA = webinar signup (we want signups for launch week). Secondary CTA = run the benchmark (link to bench-runner repo) and tertiary = request dedicated eval.

Olivia Gomez: Also prepare three 140-char captions (dev/platform/exec). I'll post drafts by EOD.

Mia Chen: Timeline: design comps Tue (2026-03-31), copy Wed AM (2026-04-01), assets live Fri (2026-04-03). Webinar slot tentatively 2026-04-09 09:00 PDT per marketing-bot. Confirm by EOD today.

marketing-bot: Webinar slot tentative: 2026-04-09 09:00 PDT. Confirm by 2026-03-29 17:00 PDT.

Samir Patel: confirmed.

Olivia Gomez: confirmed.

Jasper Li: confirmed.

Mia Chen: Next actions (short):
- Samir: produce CSV samples + chart JSON for design/eng (due 2026-03-30 EOD)
- Olivia: publish three caption drafts in this thread (due 2026-03-29 noon)
- Priya: inbound routing mapping + example UTMs (due 2026-03-30)
- Design: three card comps + accessible alt text (due 2026-03-31)

Priya Raman: Will also add suggested nurture copy for each routing bucket (short 2-line preview).

Mia Chen: Great. We'll reconvene Wed morning for a quick review. Thanks :rocket: (react :thumbsup:)
